newsitem.title: UK: British Gas sheds 5,500 staff since start of year.
newsitem.headline: British Gas sheds 5,500 staff since start of year.

text.p: British Gas Plc has lost 5,500 staff since the beginning of the year, chairman Richard Giordano said on Thursday.
Speaking at a news conference to present the company's second quarter results, Giordano said that 28,000 people have now left under the voluntary redundancy programme.
But the losses have been partly offset by the recruitment of 1,200 contract staff to oversee the introduction of the Network Code.
"More people are leaving than we anticipated and they're leaving faster," said Philip Hampton, incoming finance director.
The redundancies do not present an extra cost as they are mostly financed out of a provision of 1.3 billion stg made in 1993, he said.
On June 30, British Gas employed 43,248 people, down from 54,523 in June 1995.
